cover.invite: Let's go through it together, one step at a time.

steps.title: Finishes
steps.intro: Let's start outside. Choose the stain for the walls and watch the picture change. Picture colors are approximate; the samples are the reference.

items.label: Exterior stain
items.hint: All five stains are included in the price.

items.label: Deck configuration
items.lead: Now the deck. First, its shape and size.
items.hint: A = 3 ft and B = 5 ft is the standard 93 sq ft package at $6,900. For any other size, enter A and B to see the price: $82 per sq ft of deck. Upgraded boards are extra; you choose them next. Your manager confirms any price change to your agreement. For larger decks or other shapes, use Comments.

items.label: A dimension
items.hint: Front projection on the drawing, up to 15 ft.

items.label: B dimension
items.hint: Side projection on the drawing, up to 10 ft.

groups.title: Trex Select series
groups.text: Durable composite decking with a subtle woodgrain texture. Included when a deck is selected.

groups.title: Trex Transcend series
groups.text: Enhanced woodgrain texture, richer colours and thicker deck boards.
groups.after: Adds $12 per sq ft to a corner deck.

groups.title: TimberTech decking
groups.text: Premium composite decking with distinctive woodgrain textures and rich colour variations.
groups.after: Adds $18 per sq ft to a corner deck.

items.label: Custom decking details
items.placeholder: Describe the decking you want here.
items.hint: Your manager will contact you to discuss whether it is possible and what it may cost.

items.label: Floor colors
items.hint: All three floors are included in the price.

more.label: Laminate or engineered hardwood
text: Waterproof laminate is a practical choice for a gym or art studio and is easy to clean.
Engineered hardwood offers a more premium finish for an office or bedroom. Both floors work well. Many clients pick the color they like best.

steps.title: Add-ons
steps.intro: Would you like any of these? Please answer for each one.

items.title: Skylight
items.text: 24" x 46". Opens by hand or with a remote.

items.label: Skylight location
items.hint: This is the roof of your studio, seen from above. Tap one of the three spots.

steps.title: Electrical
steps.intro: By default Wellmade installs a 125 amp, 2 circuit breaker box 5 ft above the ground, one exterior outlet right under it, and 3 interior outlets 18" above the floor. Below you choose the connection and where everything goes.

items.label: Connection
items.hint: Choose the connection in your agreement. Hardline needs a custom quote. Ethernet adds $1,350 with hardline. For Ethernet on its own, your manager will confirm the price.

options.label: My contractor will connect the studio breaker box to the house panel (no price change)

items.label: Breaker box location
items.ask: Where should the breaker box go?
items.hint: Tap one of the four spots on the plan.

more.label: How to choose the spot
text: We generally recommend the side closest to the incoming power. You can choose a less visible spot. The box goes on an outside wall, about 5 ft above the ground.

items.label: Exterior outlet locations
items.ask: Where would you like your exterior outlets?
items.hint: One outlet is included under the breaker box by default. To move it for free, select the new spot, then deselect the old one. Each extra outlet is $500. For another location, describe the move in Comments.

items.label: Interior outlet locations
items.ask: Where would you like your interior outlets?
items.hint: Three outlets are included. Tap to remove or add a spot. Each outlet beyond three is $400. Want one elsewhere, such as behind a TV? Describe which spot to move in Comments.

steps.title: Permits
steps.intro: Last question. You probably already know whether your studio needs a permit. Not sure? Leave this empty: your manager will contact you about it.

items.label: Permitting
items.emptyText: Left empty: your manager will contact you
items.hint: Building and Electrical can be combined.

steps.title: Review
steps.intro: Please check everything once more: we order materials and build from this. Then press Send.
steps.detailsHint: Please check that these are right.
